payload.title: Improve Console target resolution
payload.description:
Improve Plexus Console score workflow reliability for ambiguous score targets.

Intent: As a Console user, I want follow-up target choices to resolve deterministically, so that score and guideline workflow requests do not loop or guess.

Definition of Done:
- Console can ask one disambiguation question and consume the follow-up answer.
- Runtime exposes a reusable score target resolver.
- Code edits remain routed through the score edit worker.
- Guidelines updates remain validation-gated.
- Targeted tests and live Console smoke evidence pass.

Confidentiality: this issue intentionally omits client-specific names, scorecard names, score names, evaluation names, and incidents.
